## Summary

What changed, and why? Link the relevant issue (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## Evidence

List the **exact commands/tools and versions** used and their results. Include relevant logs or waveform screenshots if useful. If a check was not run, state why.

- Lint:
- Simulation / assertions:
- Tested parameters / seeds:
- Synthesis / hardware (if applicable):

## Review checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to the active IP (or an approved fix to a previous IP).
- [ ] RTL follows [SystemVerilog guidelines](../docs/SYSTEMVERILOG_STYLE.md).
- [ ] Verification is self-checking and covers changed behavior.
- [ ] Reset, timing, widths, signedness, and parameter edge cases were reviewed.
- [ ] Interface/specification and per-IP README are up to date.
- [ ] No proprietary files, credentials, generated build products, or incompatible third-party code were added.
- [ ] All remaining warnings, limitations, and unrun checks are documented.
